summary: Shattuck Labs filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering is a standard equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer selling its own securities to raise capital. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is involved. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction under Rule 424(b)(5) with no special-situation triggers.
